current_p1_ru: Соло-гриндер, коллекционер, speedrunner, modder. Ты играешь один(-на). Тебе не нужны команды; нужна твоя личная цель — собрать всё, пройти быстрее, изменить под себя.
current_p1_en:
Solo grinder, collector, speedrunner, modder. You play alone. You don't need teams; you need your personal goal — collect everything, finish faster, modify to your taste.
Why it works: you have internal motivation. You don't need someone next to you pushing you; you're your own coach.
Some people don't get it: "why play alone if you can with friends?" Because you need silence and focus. With friends, it's a different pleasure.
What's worth knowing: solo games work as long as you're in focus. If you're grinding without joy, that's no longer love, it's habit. Learn to notice when that line gets crossed.

current_p1_ru: Тиммейт, профи в киберспорте, стримлю, токсик-керри. Ты в команде. Не «один в поле»; нужны люди рядом, и ты часть машинерии.
current_p1_en:
Team player, esports pro, streamer, toxic carry. You're in a team. Not "alone in the field"; you need people next to you, and you are part of the machine.
It lands because you have a social need. Games for you are a place of communication, not solitude.
You may hear people are surprised at your involvement: "you've been with these people for three years?". Three. And they're closer to me than some offline acquaintances.
What's worth knowing: team games are an emotional risk. If your team has a bad day, you'll suffer together. Learn to separate — sometimes it's worth muting voice and playing solo, to not burn out from others' emotions.

current_p1_ru: Строитель, моддер, мирный игрок, исследователь. Ты в играх не «побеждаешь»; ты создаёшь. Базы, моды, миры, маршруты — всё это твоё творчество.
current_p1_en:
Builder, modder, peaceful player, explorer. In games you don't "win"; you create. Bases, mods, worlds, routes — that is your creativity.
The logic is simple: you have a creative nature. Games for you are a palette, not an arena.
People sometimes are surprised: "you spent an hour in Minecraft just building?" An hour. And another hour. You have a whole castle there.
What's worth knowing: creative gaming is a rare school. Many gaming communities don't get it; they're about competition. Learn to find your tribe — other builders, modders, peaceful players.

current_p1_ru: Лор-гуру, RPG-философ, исследователь, мирный. Тебе важна не геймплейная сторона, а смысл. Кто эти персонажи, зачем они, что говорит игра.
current_p1_en:
Lore guru, RPG philosopher, explorer, peaceful. What matters to you isn't the gameplay side but the meaning. Who are these characters, why they are there, what is the game saying.
This fits because you have a deep relationship with narrative. Most players run through the plot; you live in it.
Some people are surprised: "you read all the NPC dialogue?". All of it. Between the lines, so much is said that without it the game is half.
What's worth knowing: focus on lore sometimes slows your gaming life. Learn to balance — sometimes run the plot for fun, sometimes dig deep. Not every game requires a doctorate in its universe.

current_p1_ru: Тактик, профи киберспорта, speedrunner, лор-гуру. Ты играешь головой. Не «реакция и адреналин» — а план, расчёт, оптимизация.
current_p1_en:
Tactician, esports pro, speedrunner, lore guru. You play with your head. Not "reaction and adrenaline" — plan, calculation, optimization.
Why it works: you have an analytical mind. In games you look for the same pleasures as in chess — wins through foresight.
You may hear people call you a "nerd": "you're calculating odds again". You are. And you win because of it.
What's worth knowing: strategists sometimes lose the feeling of play. If you're constantly "optimizing", you can forget that the main thing is enjoyment. Learn to sometimes play "non-optimally", just for emotion.

current_p1_ru: Кинестетик, casual, стримлю, токсик-керри. Ты играешь эмоционально. Не «холодная стратегия»; нужно, чтобы было ярко, чтобы было весело, чтобы было живо.
current_p1_en:
Casual, streamer, toxic carry, emotional player. You play emotionally. Not "cold strategy"; you need it to be vivid, fun, alive.
It lands because you have a lively nervous system. Games for you are an emotional session, not an intellectual one.
People sometimes worry: "why are you shouting?". You are not shouting — you are living.
What's worth knowing: emotional gaming exhausts. If every match for you is swings from rapture to rage, you're burning yourself. Learn to regulate. Not every game requires the emotional max.

current_p1_ru: Профи в киберспорте, speedrunner, тактик, стримлю. Ты не «играешь для веселья»; ты тренируешься. Часами, ежедневно, с целью.
current_p1_en:
Esports pro, speedrunner, tactician, streamer. You don't "play for fun"; you train. For hours, daily, with a goal.
The logic is simple: you have an athletic mode. Most people play to relax; you — to grow.
Some people don't get it: "you don't earn from this". Not yet. And not necessarily. You just want to do one thing well.
What's worth knowing: "I'm not a pro but I play like one" is a dangerous state. If you have no real tournaments and contract but you live like a player, you have neither balance nor income. Be honest with yourself: are you an enthusiast hobbyist, or are you drifting?

current_p1_ru: Грубость к официантам, понты, контроль, ревность без повода. Это твои стоп-сигналы. Каждый из них показывает, что человек не уважает других.
current_p1_en:
Rudeness to waiters, showing off, control, jealousy without reason. These are your stop signals. Each shows the person doesn't respect others.
Why it works: you have a strong sense for character. These signs are visible from the first minute, and you read them.
People sometimes push back: "you're strict with people". Strict, yes. Because time spent on the wrong people is still time lost.
What's worth knowing: these signs sometimes coincide with ordinary first-meeting nerves. Learn to tell pattern from case. One episode of rudeness can be a bad day; when it's systematic — character.

current_p1_ru: Нет хобби, душность, нет самоиронии, презрение к вкусам. Это твои стопы. Эти люди скучные, и ты это понимаешь сразу.
current_p1_en:
No hobbies, tediousness, no self-irony, contempt for other people's taste. These stop you cold. The person feels flat, and you understand it right away.
It works because you yourself have depth. You're bored with those who don't.
People sometimes say: "maybe they didn't have time for hobbies". Maybe. And that's information too.
What's worth knowing: "no hobbies" sometimes means "haven't found yet". Learn to tell emptiness from search. One is a flag; the other is a stage of life.

current_p1_ru: Ложь о мелочах, контроль, ревность без повода, сплетни о бывших. Это паттерн. Любая из этих черт — флаг; все вместе — это профиль токсичного партнёра.
current_p1_en:
Lies about small things, control, jealousy without reason, gossip about exes. This is a pattern. Any one of these traits is a warning sign; all together is the profile of a toxic partner.
The reason it works: you have an analytical eye. You notice not single episodes, but patterns.
People sometimes don't believe: "but they love you". Maybe. But love doesn't excuse control.
What's worth knowing: these signs are often disguised as "care". "I just worry about you" = "I want to know where you are". Learn to tell. Real care doesn't need access to your phone.

current_p1_ru: Хаос без планов, постоянные опоздания, игнор, душность. Это про неуважение ко времени. Чужому времени.
current_p1_en:
Chaos without plans, constant lateness, ignoring, dullness. This is about disrespect for time — someone else's time.
This works because you value time. Lateness "sometimes" doesn't anger you; the habit of it does.
People sometimes push back: "you're a stickler". Not a stickler — respecting time. Different things.
What's worth knowing: some people live in chaos and can't otherwise. This isn't malicious intent — it's neurochemistry. Learn to tell. If someone really tries and is ten minutes late instead of an hour — they're growing. If they don't change at all — that's not for you.

current_p1_ru: Нытьё, ревность без повода, нет самоиронии, контроль. Это про людей, которые превращают каждое взаимодействие в эмоциональный обмен энергии — и не в твою сторону.
current_p1_en:
Whining, jealousy without reason, no self-irony, control. This is about people who turn every interaction into emotional energy exchange — and not in your direction.
Why it works: you have a boundary. You understand that your nervous system isn't built for someone else's eternal "everything's bad".
People sometimes say: "you're indifferent". Not indifferent — protecting your own.
What's worth knowing: sometimes whining is just a bad period. Learn to tell "moment" from "character". Some complain for a week and then return to normal; some — for years. These are different people.

current_p1_ru: Неуважение границ, грубость к официантам, презрение к вкусам, сплетни о бывших. Это про людей, для которых другой — это инструмент, не личность.
current_p1_en:
Disrespect for boundaries, rudeness to waiters, contempt for others' tastes, gossip about exes. This is about people for whom another is a tool, not a personality.
It works because you have a clear understanding of boundaries. Not everyone sees them; you do.
People sometimes don't share it: "they're just joking". Joking, yes — but at someone else's expense. And that's not a joke, it's contempt wrapped as a joke.
What's worth knowing: people with poor boundaries are often the same with everyone, not just you. Learn to observe how they communicate with waiters, parents, strangers. This gives a full portrait.

current_p1_ru: Жадность, ложь о мелочах, нет хобби, понты. Это про людей, у которых ценности перевёрнуты. Деньги важнее людей; внешнее важнее внутреннего.
current_p1_en:
Greed, lies about tiny things, no hobbies, showing off. This is about people with their values upside down. Money is more important than people; the external more important than the internal.
The reason it works: you have a mature relationship with money and status. And you feel bad with those who don't.
People sometimes push back: "you condemn him for thrift?". Thrift isn't greed. Thrift respects money. Greed fears losing it.
What's worth knowing: greed is often disguised as "practicality". Learn to tell. A really practical person spends money on the important. The greedy don't spend on anything except insurance against loss.

current_p1_ru: Сплетни о бывших, ложь о мелочах, нет самоиронии, душность. Это про людей, которые не закрыли прошлое и тащат его в каждое новое отношение.
current_p1_en:
Gossip about exes, lies about tiny things, no self-irony, dullness. This is about people who haven't closed the past and drag it into every new relationship.
This works because you have a sense of timing. You understand — everyone has a past, but not everyone lives in it.
People sometimes don't understand: "they're sharing". Sharing — 30 minutes about an ex on a first date? That's not "sharing", that's "stuck".
What's worth knowing: an unprocessed past partner in someone else's head is your rival. And you'll always lose, because in memories that one is more ideal than any real person. Learn to leave.

current_p1_ru: Джонни Депп, Киану Ривз, Джим Керри, Эдвард Нортон. Ты любишь актёров, которые выросли в 90-х и до сих пор работают. У них есть особый стиль — ироничный, харизматичный, не вписывающийся в современные шаблоны.
current_p1_en:
Johnny Depp, Keanu Reeves, Jim Carrey, Edward Norton. You love actors who grew up in the '90s and still work. They have a special style — ironic, charismatic, not fitting modern templates.
It works because you caught them in their best years. These faces are part of the cultural memory of your generation.
People sometimes say: "he hasn't been in hits for a long time". Not in hits — but in cinema. And every role is interesting.
What's worth knowing: '90s nostalgia is good as long as it doesn't block the modern. Learn to watch new actors too. Otherwise you're a captive of the past, and the past keeps shrinking while the present passes you by.

current_p1_ru: Алан Рикман, Рэйф Файнс, Питер О'Тул, Ричард Бёртон. Тебя цепляет великая британская театральная традиция, перенесённая в кино. Голос, дикция, выверенность каждого жеста.
current_p1_en:
Alan Rickman, Ralph Fiennes, Peter O'Toole, Richard Burton. What draws you in is the great British theatrical tradition transplanted to cinema. Voice, diction, the precision of every gesture.
The reason it works: you value technique. These actors are masters of craft; not "improvisers of inspiration", but craftsmen of the highest class.
People sometimes call this "theatrical". Theatrical in the positive sense. Not all theatrical is bad.
What's worth knowing: the British school is fading now. Modern young Britons play differently, closer to the American style. Learn to value the old school while it's still accessible. Once it's gone, only recordings remain — and some of these masters never made enough recordings.

current_p1_ru: Том Круз, Харрисон Форд, Дональд Сазерленд, Джош Бролин. Ты любишь актёров, которые годами держат уровень. Они не «модные», они вечные. Каждый фильм — на ремесле.
current_p1_en:
Tom Cruise, Harrison Ford, Donald Sutherland, Josh Brolin. You love actors who hold the level for years. They're not "trendy", they're eternal. Every film — built on craft.
This works because you respect the long game. These actors proved themselves for decades, and every role rests on reliability, not experiment.
People sometimes call them "boring": "he always plays the same thing". Not the same — he plays himself in different contexts. And it works.
What's worth knowing: legends are reliable, but sometimes worth stepping outside the frame. These actors give comfort; the young give surprise. Learn to value both. A diet of only legends — and modern cinema starts to feel foreign.

current_p1_ru: Джейк Джилленхол, Майкл Фассбендер, Эдвард Нортон, Брэдли Купер. Тебе нравятся актёры, которые в каждой роли реально работают. Не «играют звезду» — а перевоплощаются.
current_p1_en:
Jake Gyllenhaal, Michael Fassbender, Edward Norton, Bradley Cooper. You like actors who really work in every role. Not "playing the star" — transforming.
Why it works: you value the giving. Most actors do what they're good at; these do what challenges them.
People are sometimes surprised how they change so much each time. They train — for years.
What's worth knowing: dramatic intensity is great, but sometimes becomes its own goal. Learn to tell "he's working" from "he's showing he's working". The first — real. The second — a game inside a game. Quiet transformation often beats demonstrative one.

current_p1_ru: Джонни Депп, Джим Керри, Стив Бушеми, Алан Рикман. Тебя цепляют актёры, у которых сильный собственный голос. Не «универсалы», которые могут всё; а специалисты по странному, по необычному.
current_p1_en:
Johnny Depp, Jim Carrey, Steve Buscemi, Alan Rickman. What draws you in are actors with a strong own voice. Not "all-rounders" who can do everything; specialists in the strange, the unusual.
It works because you love individuality. Actors who "fit in" bore you; you need those with a signature, recognizable from the first second.
People are sometimes surprised: "he's strangely played in every role". Strangeness is his signature. And that's exactly why you love him.
What's worth knowing: eccentric actors sometimes can't play "normally". That's both strength and limitation. Value the signature, but don't make a role for them where it doesn't fit — even great talent breaks against the wrong material.

current_p1_ru: Стив Бушеми, Дональд Сазерленд, Питер О'Тул, Харрисон Форд. Тебе нравятся актёры второго плана, которые в каждом фильме — событие. Они не «звёзды», но без них фильм беднее.
current_p1_en:
Steve Buscemi, Donald Sutherland, Peter O'Toole, Harrison Ford. You like supporting actors who in every film become the event. They're not "stars", but without them the film is poorer.
The reason it works: you have an eye for the ensemble. Most people watch only the main hero; you notice who in three minutes of screen time creates miracles.
People sometimes don't remember them by name: "who was that?". That's a great actor who isn't a star, but a master.
What's worth knowing: these actors are often more interesting in small roles than in big ones. Value the niche. And remember: a cameo is often harder work than the lead — you have to make a character work in three minutes, not three hours.

current_p1_ru: Брэдли Купер, Джейк Джилленхол, Майкл Фассбендер, Джош Бролин. Эти актёры в работе ещё, и Оскар у них впереди. Ты ценишь их именно потому, что они на пути.
current_p1_en:
Bradley Cooper, Jake Gyllenhaal, Michael Fassbender, Josh Brolin. These actors are still working, and the Oscar is ahead of them. You value them precisely because they're on the way.
This works because you love the living. Most classics are end-of-career; these are mid-career. And you grow with them as a viewer.
People sometimes say: "they didn't get an Oscar". Yet. And they don't have to — that doesn't undo anything.
What's worth knowing: "no Oscar" is sometimes a compliment. Many greats never got one (Peter O'Toole was nominated 8 times). Don't confuse absence of award with absence of talent. The Academy has its blind spots; you don't have to share them.

current_p1_ru: Тату, Ленинград, ранняя Земфира, Тимати — у тебя в плейлисте 00-х живёт энергия бунта и провокации. Ты помнишь, что эти артисты были не просто «попса того времени» — они шокировали, давили, нарушали правила.
current_p1_en:
t.A.T.u., Leningrad, early Zemfira, Timati — the energy of rebellion and provocation lives in your 00s playlist. You remember these artists weren't just pop from that time — they shocked, pushed, broke rules.
It works because you have memory of how fresh it was. t.A.T.u. — two girls playing at a romance, and the whole world discussed them. Leningrad with profanity that was banned on air. Zemfira with songs that seemed "too much". In the 00s it was all new.
People sometimes don't understand how big it was: "t.A.T.u. is just t.A.T.u.". And you remember the whole world looked at Russian pop through them then. It was our first global pop story.
What's worth knowing: nostalgia for the 00s rebellion sometimes prevents seeing the 20s rebellion. There are provocateurs now too, just in another language. If you're only in the past, you miss the living troublemakers of the present. Learn to hear across eras. Rebellion is an eternal genre, and each decade has its own heroes.

current_p1_ru: Дискотека Авария, Руки Вверх, Дима Билан, Smash!! — твой саундтрек выпускных, школьных дискотек, ранних клубов. Это не «глубокая музыка», это музыка тела и момента.
current_p1_en:
Diskoteka Avariya, Ruki Vverh, Dima Bilan, Smash!! — your soundtrack of graduations, school discos, early clubs. This isn't "deep music", it's music of the body and the moment.
The reason it works: these tracks are wired in you at a reflex level. You turn it on — and you don't "listen", you're immediately there. On the parquet, for the first time, with those you no longer talk to but remember to this day.
People sometimes get snobby: "that's primitive pop". You smile. Primitive — yes, but what an effect! This primitive pop does to you what the most complex albums won't — instantly returns you to age 15.
What's worth knowing: 00s dance pop works only with those who lived it. Young people now hear "cringe" in it, and that's normal. Don't try to convince — it's yours, and it stays yours. Just keep it as a capsule: for your moments, for your company.

current_p1_ru: Алсу, Андрей Губин, Корни, Smash!! — твоя лиричная сторона 00-х. Тебе важны были песни, в которых есть история, чувство, лёгкая грусть. Не «зажечь танцпол», а «послушать в плеере, глядя в окно автобуса».
current_p1_en:
Alsou, Andrey Gubin, Korni, Smash!! — your lyrical side of the 00s. What mattered to you were songs that have a story, a feeling, a light sadness. Not "light up the dancefloor", but "listen to in headphones, looking out the bus window".
This works because in the 00s the Russian pop scene still knew how to be lyrical without ironic break. Just direct pop, without irony and without hype. Now there's almost nothing like that left.
People are sometimes surprised: "you listen to Gubin?". Yes. And you're surprised that at 25 he wrote lyrics deeper than many modern "deep" artists at 35.
What's worth knowing: 00s lyrical pop has its own subtlety that's hard to convey to a new listener. If you try to "sell" Gubin to a friend — they may hear only the arrangement, not the text, and say "pop is pop". Learn to value silently. Not every pleasure requires sharing.

current_p1_ru: Serebro, ВИА Гра, Фабрика, Краски — твой женский поп-гламур 00-х. Это были годы, когда в России начали серьёзно делать гёрл-группы, и ты застал это поколение в его пиковой форме.
current_p1_en:
Serebro, VIA Gra, Fabrika, Kraski — your female pop glamour of the 00s. These were the years when Russia started seriously making girl groups, and you caught this generation in its peak form.
Why it works: you have an ear for the industry. You understand Serebro and VIA Gra weren't "random teams", they were producer projects with a thought-out concept. And you're interested in following how it worked.
People sometimes devalue: "glamour pop, girls in dresses". Not only. Behind every such group stood real work: vocals, choreography, image. It was the first school of Russian girl groups, and K-pop hadn't even appeared with us yet.
What's worth knowing: glamour pop ages quickly visually. When you watch 00s clips now, the dating is visible. But it often still sounds good. Learn to separate one from the other: visual is the film of an era, the soundtrack — can be more eternal than it seems.

current_p1_ru: Иванушки International, Smash!!, Корни, Дима Билан — у тебя в памяти боя-бэнды и сольники-сердцееды 00-х. Те, кто заполнял женские мечты и плакаты на стенах подростковых комнат.
current_p1_en:
Ivanushki International, Smash!!, Korni, Dima Bilan — boy bands and solo heartthrobs of the 00s in your memory. Those who filled female dreams and posters on the walls of teenage rooms.
It works because you have a specific connection with this aesthetic. Maybe you were a fan, maybe your friends were, maybe it was the background of your childhood. In any case you remember what these guys meant.
People sometimes laugh: "Ivanushki International, seriously?". Seriously. They were an industry. Then there weren't "three main boy bands of the world"; in Russia Ivanushki were the peak of this genre.
What's worth knowing: 00s boy bands often sound awkward now. That's normal. The aesthetic was different, and don't try to defend it before skeptics — they won't hear it. Just enjoy in solitude, for your own pleasure.

current_p1_ru: Ранняя Земфира, лиричный Губин, Алсу с её сказочной чистотой, Корни с подростковой нежностью. Ты слушал(-а) то, что было хрупким и честным посреди шумной эпохи 00-х.
current_p1_en:
Early Zemfira, lyrical Gubin, Alsou with her fairy-tale purity, Korni with teenage tenderness. You listened to what was fragile and honest in the noisy 00s.
This works because you knew how to hear the quiet in the loud. The 00s were years of provocation and dancefloor; and in this stream only real fragility survived, because it was the opposite of the whole era. And you defended it with your own listening.
People are sometimes surprised by your taste: "you have Alsou and Zemfira at the same time?". Yes. They're two sides of one fragility — one fairy-tale, the other rebellious. And both about what was hard to keep in an era of mass noise.
What's worth knowing: fragile music requires silence around to be heard. In a noisy life it gets lost, and over time you can stop hearing it. Learn to regularly create silence — an hour without notifications, headphones, a window — and in it listen to those who write subtly. Otherwise the subtle dies from your own busyness.

current_p1_ru: Друзья, Альф, Женаты с детьми, Бивис и Баттхед. Тебе ближе ситкомы 90-х. Простая структура, любимые персонажи, ежедневный смех.
current_p1_en:
Friends, ALF, Married... with Children, Beavis and Butt-Head. Sitcoms of the '90s are closer to you. Simple structure, beloved characters, daily laughter.
It works because you love comfort. After a hard day you need Joey, not Twin Peaks.
People sometimes get snobby: "Friends is basic". Basic. And wonderful.
What's worth knowing: Friends in 2024 is a different show than in 1994. Modern viewers see "toxic" elements. Learn to watch in the era's context. Don't judge what was made 30 years ago by today's standards.

current_p1_ru: Твин Пикс, Секретные материалы, Баффи, Друзья. Тебя цепляли сериалы с тайной. Не «обычная драма»; а что-то странное за углом.
current_p1_en:
Twin Peaks, The X-Files, Buffy, Friends. What drew you in were series with a mystery. Not "ordinary drama"; something strange around the corner.
The reason it works: you love puzzles. A straight narrative bores you; you need something to unravel.
People sometimes don't get it: "Twin Peaks is weird". Weird. And beautiful.
What's worth knowing: '90s mystery series often don't have "normal" finales. If you expect Lynch to explain — you'll be disappointed. Learn to accept the mystery as part of the work.
